        bullets = 0
        while monsters:
            new_monsters = []
            for i in range(len(monsters)):
                a_i, b_i = monsters[i]
                if a_i > 0:
                    bullets += 1
                    a_i -= 1
                    if a_i == 0 and i + 1 < len(monsters):
                        monsters[i + 1] = (monsters[i + 1][0] - b_i, monsters[i + 1][1])
                    elif a_i == 0 and i + 1 == len(monsters):
                        monsters[0] = (monsters[0][0] - b_i, monsters[0][1])

                if a_i > 0:
                    new_monsters.append((a_i, b_i))
            monsters = new_monsters
        results.append(str(bullets))
    print("\n".join(results))
